2608.22223.title: Spending Scarce Confirmatory PET Measurements: Target-Aligned Validation in A4/LEARN
2608.22223.paper_summary: Anti-amyloid therapies and blood-based biomarkers are changing Alzheimer disease workups into a two-stage measurement workflow: screen broadly with cheaper information, then spend scarce confirmatory amyloid measurements where they support the decision that will be reported. Amyloid positron-emission tomography (PET) remains one such protocol measurement for amyloid burden, but PET slots, trial budgets, and payer-facing evidence packages are finite. This paper asks a deliberately operational question: when is simple transparent PET validation enough, and when is a fitted residual-uncertainty score worth the added complexity? For a weighted protocol target, the first-order value of validating subject i is the product of target influence and residual protocol uncertainty. Generic uncertainty sampling uses only the second factor and can spend PET measurements on subjects that are hard to predict but weak for the scientific, clinical, or commercial claim. We apply this rule to the A4/LEARN PET archive, treating observed PET as a design laboratory for scarce-confirmation studies. For the primary APOE4 carrier versus non-carrier contrast in Centiloid 24-or-higher PET positivity, simple APOE4-balanced validation recovers nearly all of the target-specific gain: at PET budget 200, the confidence-interval width ratio relative to random validation is 0.923 for APOE4 balancing and 0.914 for target-specific scoring, while generic uncertainty sampling is 0.980. Other targets behave differently: target-specific scoring gives larger gains for an age-slope analysis and for cutoff-indexed PET positivity. The practical message is simple: spend scarce protocol measurements according to the claim being validated, not only according to prediction uncertainty.
2608.22223.paper_summary_zh: 抗類澱粉療法和血液生物標記正在將阿茲海默病的檢查轉變為兩階段的測量工作流程：首先使用較便宜的信息進行廣泛篩查，然後在支持將被報告的決策時花費稀缺的確認性類澱粉測量。類澱粉正電子發射斷層掃描（PET）仍然是測量類澱粉負擔的一種協議測量，但PET的名額、試驗預算和面向支付者的證據包都是有限的。本文提出了一個故意的操作性問題：何時簡單透明的PET驗證足夠，何時擬合的殘差不確定性分數值得增加的複雜性？對於加權協議目標，驗證受試者i的第一階值是目標影響和殘差協議不確定性的乘積。通用不確定性抽樣僅使用第二個因素，並可以將PET測量花費在難以預測但對科學、臨床或商業主張較弱的受試者上。我們將這一規則應用於A4/LEARN PET存檔，將觀察到的PET視為稀缺確認研究的設計實驗室。對於Centiloid 24或更高PET陽性中的主要APOE4攜帶者與非攜帶者對比，簡單的APOE4平衡驗證幾乎恢復了所有目標特定的增益：在PET預算200時，相對於隨機驗證的置信區間寬度比率，APOE4平衡為0.923，目標特定計分為0.914，而通用不確定性抽樣為0.980。其他目標的行為則不同：目標特定計分對於年齡斜率分析和截止指數PET陽性給予更大的增益。實際信息很簡單：根據正在驗證的主張花費稀缺的協議測量，而不僅僅是根據預測不確定性。
